Licenses of the PLATO terminal core for MiSTer

platod (the ARM program in this folder)
  Derived from PTerm 6.0.4 by Paul Koning, Joe Stanton, Dale Sinder et al.
  (https://www.cyber1.org/pterm.asp).  This is an ALTERED SOURCE VERSION of
  PTerm: the wxWidgets user interface was replaced by the MiSTer frame
  buffer, keyboard, mouse and sound.  It is distributed under the PTerm
  license, see pterm-license.txt.
  The Z80 emulator (z80emu) is by Lin Ke-Fong and is free to use.

PLATO_<date>.rbf (the FPGA core)
  Based on the MiSTer framework (Template_MiSTer, sys/) and distributed
